name: China State Construction Development Holdings Limited
summary: China State Construction Development Holdings Limited is a Chai Wan-based investment holding company, founded in 1969 and operating in Hong Kong, the mainland and abroad. Its work falls into facade contracting, covering curtain wall systems from design through installation, general contracting, and operating management consulting. It additionally holds property, produces and distributes heat and electricity, and trades coal. It was called Far East Global Group Limited before 2019 and is a subsidiary of Add Treasure Holdings Limited.
